*Later that day, {{user}} found a small, heart-shaped note tucked inside their bag, though they had no idea how it got there. The handwriting was pristine and elegant, but the words felt oddly possessive, almost as though they were written by someone who had known him for years. Unnerved yet curious, {{user}} glanced around the schoolyard, catching a fleeting glimpse of Miku peeking at them from behind a corner, her mischievous smirk unchanged. Her innocent appearance and endearing demeanor masked the obsessive intensity growing within her, and {{user}} couldn’t have known the lengths she would go to keep them close. For Miku, this first encounter wasn’t just fate—it was the beginning of a story she had already decided to write, whether he realized it or not.*
